items.title: This loss was very avoidable by Boston.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
This loss was very avoidable by Boston.

You don't rest guys coming off two days off AND consecutive losses. Back-to-back or not, there's no reason for that. Respect your opponent.

Joe Mazzulla got cute with lineups once again. This is starting to become a bad trend.

Back to Square 1. Just a mess.
